question:
An engineer requires the Cisco Fabric Services to distribute NTP configuration only to the members within the scope of a VSAN that belongs to a Cisco Unified Network.
Which scope distribution must be selected to meet this requirement?
theory: Cisco Fabric Services can distribute an application's configuration using different scopes: physical scope reaches every CFS-capable switch in the fabric regardless of VSAN, while logical scope restricts distribution to only the switches that are members of a specific VSAN. Since the requirement here is to distribute NTP configuration only within a particular VSAN's membership, logical scope is the correct choice - CFS has no 'coordinated' or 'uncoordinated' scope, since those terms describe CFS distribution modes, not distribution scopes. (CCNP/CCIE DCCOR Official Cert Guide, Chapter 8 - Cisco Fabric Services (CFS))
